title: Present Simple
subtitle: Things we do every day
review: Written by Claude. Check the Burmese, Spanish, Hindi and Vietnamese (explanations and scene translations) and the answers. No pictures or audio yet.
intro: Emma gets up at six, Lucas thinks in bed, and Mr. Tan next door does everything. Four short scenes, then the rule, the mistakes to watch for, practice and a quiz.
clips: I get up at six every day.
I get up at six too.
No. You hear the alarm at six. You get up at eight.
I think in bed. It is work.
Yes. He runs, he swims, and he cooks dinner.
No. I don't eat cake. I don't drink cola.
And the chocolate in your bag?

subtitle.es: Cosas que hacemos todos los días
subtitle.vi: Những việc ta làm hằng ngày
subtitle.hi: जो काम हम रोज़ करते हैं

scenes.title: The Morning
scenes.image_note: Bedroom, early morning. Emma dressed and awake by the window; Lucas still in bed under the blanket, alarm clock showing 6:00.

lines.text: I [[get up]] at six every day.

tr.my: ကျွန်မ နေ့တိုင်း ခြောက်နာရီ အိပ်ရာထတယ်။
tr.es: Me levanto a las seis todos los días.
tr.vi: Ngày nào em cũng dậy lúc sáu giờ.
tr.hi: मैं रोज़ छह बजे उठती हूँ।

tr.my: ကျွန်တော်လည်း ခြောက်နာရီ ထတယ်။
tr.es: Yo también me levanto a las seis.
tr.vi: Anh cũng dậy lúc sáu giờ.
tr.hi: मैं भी छह बजे उठता हूँ।

lines.text: No. You [[hear]] the alarm at six. You [[get up]] at eight.

tr.my: မဟုတ်ဘူး။ ရှင်က ခြောက်နာရီမှာ နှိုးစက်သံ ကြားတာ။ ရှစ်နာရီမှ ထတာ။
tr.es: No. Tú oyes la alarma a las seis. Te levantas a las ocho.
tr.vi: Không. Sáu giờ anh nghe chuông báo thức. Tám giờ anh mới dậy.
tr.hi: नहीं। तुम छह बजे अलार्म सुनते हो। उठते आठ बजे हो।

lines.text: I [[think]] in bed. It is work.

tr.my: ကျွန်တော် အိပ်ရာထဲမှာ စဉ်းစားတာ။ အဲဒါ အလုပ်ပဲ။
tr.es: Pienso en la cama. Es trabajo.
tr.vi: Anh nằm trên giường suy nghĩ. Đó là làm việc.
tr.hi: मैं बिस्तर में सोचता हूँ। वह काम है।

scenes.title: The Neighbour
scenes.image_note: Emma and Lucas at the window with coffee, watching a fit older neighbour jog past in the street.

tr.my: မစ္စတာတန်က မနက်တိုင်း ပြေးတယ်။
tr.es: El señor Tan corre todas las mañanas.
tr.vi: Sáng nào ông Tan cũng chạy bộ.
tr.hi: मिस्टर टैन हर सुबह दौड़ते हैं।

tr.vi: Ông ấy chạy á? Sáng nào cũng chạy?
tr.hi: दौड़ते हैं? हर सुबह?

lines.text: Yes. He [[runs]], he [[swims]], and he [[cooks]] dinner.

tr.my: ဟုတ်တယ်။ သူ ပြေးတယ်၊ ရေကူးတယ်၊ ညစာလည်း ချက်တယ်။
tr.es: Sí. Corre, nada y prepara la cena.
tr.vi: Ừ. Ông ấy chạy bộ, bơi, rồi nấu bữa tối.
tr.hi: हाँ। वे दौड़ते हैं, तैरते हैं और रात का खाना बनाते हैं।

tr.my: အင်း။
tr.vi: Hừm.
tr.hi: हम्म।

tr.my: ပန်းကန်လည်း ဆေးတယ်။
tr.vi: Và ông ấy rửa bát nữa.
tr.hi: और बर्तन भी धोते हैं।

tr.my: ကျွန်တော် မစ္စတာတန်ကို မကြိုက်ဘူး။
tr.es: No me cae bien el señor Tan.
tr.vi: Anh không thích ông Tan.
tr.hi: मुझे मिस्टर टैन पसंद नहीं।

scenes.title: The Diet
scenes.image_note: Kitchen table. Emma with a salad, looking proud; Lucas pointing at her open handbag with a chocolate bar sticking out.

tr.my: ကျွန်မ သကြား မစားဘူး။
tr.vi: Em không ăn đường.
tr.hi: मैं चीनी नहीं खाती।

tr.vi: Em không ăn đường à?
tr.hi: तुम चीनी नहीं खातीं?

lines.text: No. I [[don't eat]] cake. I [[don't drink]] cola.

tr.my: မစားဘူး။ ကိတ်မုန့် မစားဘူး။ ကိုလာ မသောက်ဘူး။
tr.es: No. No como pastel. No tomo refresco.
tr.vi: Không. Em không ăn bánh ngọt. Em không uống nước ngọt.
tr.hi: नहीं। मैं केक नहीं खाती। मैं कोला नहीं पीती।

lines.text: And the chocolate in your bag?

tr.my: အိတ်ထဲက ချောကလက်ကရော။
tr.es: ¿Y el chocolate que traes en la bolsa?
tr.vi: Thế thanh sô-cô-la trong túi em thì sao?
tr.hi: और तुम्हारे बैग वाली चॉकलेट?

tr.my: အဲဒီ ချောကလက်ကို ထည့်မတွက်ဘူး။
tr.vi: Sô-cô-la đó không tính.
tr.hi: वह चॉकलेट नहीं गिनी जाती।

scenes.title: The Questions
scenes.image_note: Sofa in the evening. Lucas asking earnestly; Emma reading; a cat asleep on the armchair that is clearly Lucas's.

tr.vi: Em có yêu anh không?
tr.hi: क्या तुम मुझसे प्यार करती हो?

tr.my: ချစ်တယ်။
tr.vi: Có.

tr.my: မင်းအမေကရော ကျွန်တော့်ကို ချစ်လား။
tr.vi: Mẹ em có yêu quý anh không?
tr.hi: क्या तुम्हारी माँ मुझसे प्यार करती हैं?

tr.my: အမေက ရှင့်ကို သဘောကျတယ်။
tr.vi: Mẹ thấy anh cũng được.
tr.hi: वे तुम्हें पसंद करती हैं।

tr.vi: Con mèo có thích anh không?
tr.hi: क्या बिल्ली मुझे पसंद करती है?

tr.my: ကြောင်က ရှင့်ကုလားထိုင်ကို သဘောကျတယ်။
tr.es: A la gata le gusta tu silla.
tr.vi: Con mèo thích cái ghế của anh.
tr.hi: बिल्ली को तुम्हारी कुर्सी पसंद है।

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၁ တွင် I နှင့် you နောက်က ကြိယာ ပြောင်းသလား။
q.en: Scene 1: does the verb change after I and you?
q.es: Escena 1: ¿cambia el verbo después de I y you?
q.vi: Cảnh 1: sau I và you, động từ có thay đổi không?
q.hi: दृश्य 1: क्या I और you के बाद क्रिया बदलती है?

a.my: မပြောင်းပါ။ I [[get up]]၊ you [[get up]]။

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၂ တွင် he နောက်က ကြိယာ၌ ဘာစာလုံး ပိုလာသလဲ။
q.en: Scene 2: what letter is added to the verb after he?
q.es: Escena 2: ¿qué letra se añade al verbo después de he?
q.vi: Cảnh 2: sau he, động từ được thêm chữ gì?
q.hi: दृश्य 2: he के बाद क्रिया में कौन सा अक्षर जुड़ता है?

a.my: [[-s]] ပိုလာသည် (runs, swims, cooks)။ wash တွင်မူ [[-es]] (washes)။
a.en: [[-s]]: runs, swims, cooks. With wash it is [[-es]]: washes.
a.es: [[-s]]: runs, swims, cooks. Con wash es [[-es]]: washes.
a.vi: [[-s]]: runs, swims, cooks. Với wash thì thêm [[-es]]: washes.
a.hi: [[-s]]: runs, swims, cooks. wash में [[-es]] जुड़ता है: washes.

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၃ တွင် doesn't နောက်က ကြိယာ၌ -s ပါသလား။
q.en: Scene 3: is there an -s on the verb after doesn't?
q.es: Escena 3: ¿lleva -s el verbo después de doesn't?
q.vi: Cảnh 3: sau doesn't, động từ có -s không?
q.hi: दृश्य 3: क्या doesn't के बाद क्रिया में -s है?

a.my: မပါပါ။ doesn't [[count]]။ -s သည် doe[[s]] ထဲသို့ ရောက်သွားပြီ။
a.en: No. doesn't [[count]]. The -s has moved into doe[[s]].
a.es: No. doesn't [[count]]. La -s ya está en doe[[s]].
a.vi: Không. doesn't [[count]]. Chữ -s đã nằm trong doe[[s]] rồi.
a.hi: नहीं। doesn't [[count]]. -s अब doe[[s]] में चला गया है।

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၄ တွင် မေးခွန်းများသည် ဘာစကားလုံးဖြင့် စသလဲ။
q.en: Scene 4: which word starts each question?
q.es: Escena 4: ¿con qué palabra empieza cada pregunta?
q.vi: Cảnh 4: mỗi câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng từ nào?
q.hi: दृश्य 4: हर सवाल किस शब्द से शुरू होता है?

a.my: you အတွက် [[Do]]၊ your mother / the cat အတွက် [[Does]]။
a.en: [[Do]] for you. [[Does]] for your mother and the cat.
a.es: [[Do]] con you. [[Does]] con your mother y the cat.
a.vi: [[Do]] đi với you. [[Does]] đi với your mother và the cat.
a.hi: you के साथ [[Do]]. your mother और the cat के साथ [[Does]].

my: နေ့တိုင်း၊ အမြဲ၊ ပုံမှန် လုပ်လေ့ရှိသော အရာများအတွက် Present Simple ကို သုံးသည်။
I / you / we / they နောက်တွင် ကြိယာ မပြောင်းပါ။ he / she / it နောက်တွင် ကြိယာ၌ [[-s]] (သို့) [[-es]] ထည့်ရသည်။
အငြင်းဝါကျ − [[don't]] / [[doesn't]] + ကြိယာ မူရင်းပုံစံ (-s မပါ)။
en: Use the present simple for things you do every day, always or usually.
After I / you / we / they the verb does not change. After he / she / it add [[-s]] or [[-es]].
In many languages the verb never changes. In English it does, so remember the [[-s]].
Question: put [[Do]] / [[Does]] first, then use the basic verb.
es: Usa el present simple para lo que haces todos los días, siempre o normalmente.
Después de I / you / we / they el verbo no cambia. Después de he / she / it añade [[-s]] o [[-es]].
En español cambia toda la terminación (corro, corre). En inglés solo cambia con he / she / it, y por eso la [[-s]] se olvida fácilmente.
Negación: [[don't]] / [[doesn't]] + verbo base (sin -s). No basta con poner no.
Pregunta: [[Do]] / [[Does]] al principio y luego el verbo base. Y el sujeto siempre se dice: [[He]] runs, no solo Runs.
vi: Dùng thì hiện tại đơn cho việc bạn làm hằng ngày, luôn luôn hoặc thường xuyên.
Sau I / you / we / they, động từ giữ nguyên. Sau he / she / it, thêm [[-s]] hoặc [[-es]].
Trong tiếng Việt động từ không bao giờ đổi dạng. Trong tiếng Anh thì có, nên đừng quên [[-s]].
Phủ định: [[don't]] / [[doesn't]] + động từ nguyên mẫu (không có -s).
Câu hỏi: đặt [[Do]] / [[Does]] lên đầu câu, sau đó dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.
hi: जो काम आप रोज़, हमेशा या आम तौर पर करते हैं, उनके लिए present simple का प्रयोग करें।
I / you / we / they के बाद क्रिया नहीं बदलती। he / she / it के बाद क्रिया में [[-s]] या [[-es]] जोड़ें।
हिंदी में 'मैं रोज़ जाता हूँ' कहते हैं, पर अंग्रेज़ी में यहाँ am / is + -ing नहीं लगता: I [[go]] every day, I am going नहीं।
प्रश्न: [[Do]] / [[Does]] सबसे पहले, फिर क्रिया का मूल रूप।

intro.en: The [[-s]] ending has three sounds. Tap to listen, and do not drop the ending.
intro.es: La terminación [[-s]] tiene tres sonidos. Toca para escuchar y no te comas el final.
intro.vi: Đuôi [[-s]] có ba cách đọc. Chạm để nghe, và đừng bỏ âm cuối.
intro.hi: [[-s]] की तीन ध्वनियाँ होती हैं। सुनने के लिए टैप करें, और अंत की ध्वनि न छोड़ें।

note.es: En inglés el sujeto siempre se dice.
No + verbo no funciona. Usa don't / doesn't.

mistakes.wrong: I am getting up at six every day.
mistakes.right: I [[get up]] at six every day.

note.hi: रोज़ की आदत के लिए present simple, am + -ing नहीं।

note.vi: Không nói very like. Dùng like ... very much, và nhớ thêm -s.

note.my: he / she / it နောက်တွင် -s ထည့်ပါ။
note.es: Añade -s después de he / she / it.
note.hi: he / she / it के बाद -s जोड़ें।

note.my: he / she / it အတွက် doesn't ကို သုံးပါ။
note.en: Use doesn't with he / she / it.
note.es: Con he / she / it se usa doesn't.
note.vi: Với he / she / it, dùng doesn't.
note.hi: he / she / it के साथ doesn't लगाएँ।

note.my: doesn't နောက်တွင် -s မထည့်ရ။
Does ပါပြီးလျှင် ကြိယာတွင် -s မထည့်ရ။
note.en: With Does, the verb has no -s.
note.es: Con Does, el verbo va sin -s.
note.vi: Có Does rồi thì động từ không thêm -s.
note.hi: Does के साथ क्रिया में -s नहीं लगता।

note.my: မေးခွန်းတွင် Do / Does လိုသည်။ အသံကို မြှင့်ရုံနှင့် မလုံလောက်ပါ။
note.en: A question needs Do / Does. A rising voice is not enough.
note.es: La pregunta necesita Do / Does. No basta con la entonación.
note.vi: Câu hỏi cần Do / Does. Lên giọng thôi thì chưa đủ.
note.hi: प्रश्न में Do / Does चाहिए। सिर्फ़ आवाज़ ऊँची करना काफ़ी नहीं।

prompt.my: ကြိယာတွင် -s ထည့်ရမလား

answers: He does not wash the dishes.

items.s: Does Lucas gets up at six?
answers: Does Lucas get up at six?
